sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Record current state before test
seg = current_frame.segmentation
current_pink = []
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'B' and 10 < node['pixels'] < 20:
        boundary = node['boundary']
        if boundary:
            r0 = boundary[0][0]
            if 50 <= r0 <= 58:
                current_pink.append((node['hash'][:8], boundary[0][1]))
current_pink.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
print("Before UP:", current_pink)

# Press UP once
result = action(['UP'])

# Check what changed
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
after_pink = []
for node in seg2['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'B' and 10 < node['pixels'] < 20:
        boundary = node['boundary']
        if boundary:
            r0 = boundary[0][0]
            if 50 <= r0 <= 58:
                after_pink.append((node['hash'][:8], boundary[0][1]))
after_pink.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
print("After UP:", after_pink)

# Find which position changed
for i, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(current_pink, after_pink)):
    if before != after:
        print(f"Position {i} changed: {before} -> {after}")
    else:
        print(f"Position {i} unchanged: {before}")

print("\nResult:", result.get('board_changed'), result.get('gameplay_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
